why:
the action server's constructor. rclcpp_action reaches a server through `rclcpp_action::create_server(...)`, which returns a `SharedPtr`; ours is constructed into caller-owned storage by `Node::create_action_server` -- the `out-param-first` and `no-shared-ptr` rules, because there is no allocator (RFC-0022). See `cpp:ActionServerStorage` for the buffer a component declares, and `cpp:Publisher::Publisher<M>` for the same shape one entity over. The theirs-only half is `cpp:Server::Server<ActionT>`.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
